notes: Tiers 4-5 added 2026-07-24: the frontier scored 15-16/18 on tiers 1-3, above the bank's ceiling, so it could not separate models. Their answer keys are derived by exhaustive solve in tools/generate-hard-items.py. 1.2 adds category G (evidence sufficiency): rulebooks whose conditions are sometimes unstated. Frontier models solve every well-posed deterministic item in this bank, but silently default an unstated condition rather than reporting it — G measures that, with convergent and fully-specified controls so a model cannot game it by always answering UNDETERMINED.

defaultRun.composition: 2 per reasoning category (A-F) + the whole 16-item G family
defaultRun.rationale: tiers 1-3 are saturated for frontier models and contribute no discrimination
